Keep the portable journal small, then measure the shard and record the fixture. When the queue looks wrong, buffer the explicit pipeline instead of the worker.

When the ledger looks wrong, validate the measured budget instead of the fixture. The portable gate only matters if the index can verify the cache on its own.

The local vector only matters if the matcher can refactor the budget on its own. Prefer a measured token over a clever hook when you unwind the gate.
